findings.message: React.Fragment used inside .map() without a key prop — fragments wrapping <tr> and the expanded <tr> are keyless, causing React reconciliation warnings and potential rendering bugs
findings.suggestion: Replace <> ... </> with <React.Fragment key={item.id}> ... </React.Fragment> so each fragment pair has the item.id key

findings.message: No error state handling — usePartnerCatalog isError is destructured nowhere; a network failure renders neither an error message nor a retry action
findings.suggestion: Destructure isError from usePartnerCatalog and render a user-friendly error message with a retry button when isError is true

findings.message: Non-404 errors have no user-facing feedback — only 404 is handled; any other API error (5xx, network failure) leaves the sheet blank with no message or retry
findings.suggestion: Add an else branch for isError && !is404 that renders an error message and a retry button

findings.message: Error state has no retry action — displays a plain text error message with no way for the user to retry the failed request
findings.suggestion: Add a retry Button that re-triggers the query, consistent with the pattern used in GlobalCatalogAdminPage

findings.message: Table has no horizontal scroll wrapper — on small screens the table overflows the viewport without a scroll mechanism
findings.suggestion: Wrap the <div className='rounded-md border'> in an <div className='overflow-x-auto'> container

findings.message: Table has no horizontal scroll wrapper — on small screens the table overflows without a scroll mechanism
findings.suggestion: Wrap the table container <div className='rounded-md border'> in an <div className='overflow-x-auto'> container

findings.message: Hardcoded Tailwind color classes border-amber-400 and text-amber-600 used for 'Globally inactive' badge instead of semantic CSS custom property tokens
findings.suggestion: Use warning token classes — e.g. className='ml-2 border-warning/60 text-warning' — to align with the --warning HSL token defined in index.css

findings.message: Template literal used for conditional className instead of cn() helper — `w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5 ${sync.isPending ? 'animate-spin' : ''}` leaves a trailing space when not spinning
findings.suggestion: Use cn('w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5', sync.isPending && 'animate-spin') for clean conditional class merging

findings.message: Hardcoded pageSize: 20 with no pagination UI — table silently truncates at 20 items with no way to navigate to further pages
findings.suggestion: Either add pagination controls (consistent with GlobalCatalogAdminPage) or increase pageSize to a practical ceiling and document the limitation

findings.message: Processing Mode Override Select has no htmlFor/id linkage — the Label above it has no htmlFor attribute and SelectTrigger has no id, breaking label–input association for screen readers
findings.suggestion: Add id='processingModeOverride' to SelectTrigger and htmlFor='processingModeOverride' to the Label

findings.message: Category Select has no error display — errors.category is never rendered beneath the select even though the field is required
No prefers-reduced-motion consideration — the Switch toggle and Delete button interactions have no reduced-motion handling, though this is low severity as shadcn/ui handles most transitions
findings.suggestion: No immediate action required; shadcn/ui components respect reduced-motion internally

findings.message: Page root div lacks animate-route-in class — other pages use this for staggered child entrance animations consistent with the route transition pattern in index.css
findings.suggestion: Add className='animate-route-in' to the outer div to match the route transition pattern used by other pages

findings.suggestion: Add className='animate-route-in' to the outer div
